_comment: What people are usually looking for when they search a word. «words»: what they type (German, or Persian; German typed in Persian letters is read as German first). «results»: the pages that answer that need, best first, each with one line written for that need. These come first in the results; the search fills up the rest. assets/ui.js reads this file.
